sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Breaches first: changes in operation outside their controls. Then due this week, then housekeeping.
sections.sql: select code, site, title, owner, rule, detail, days from change_attention order by severity, days desc nulls last, code

sections.title: Waiting on sign-off
sections.sql: select code, site, title, risk_level as risk, status, approvals_missing as missing, age_days from change_register where approvals_missing <> '' and status in ('review','approved','started_up') order by age_days desc

name: temporary
title: Temporary and emergency changes in place

sections.title: In operation
sections.note: A temporary change past its expiry is a breach of its own approval. Extend it with a reason or put the plant back.
sections.sql: select code, site, title, classification as class, started_up_on, expires_on, case when expires_on is null then null else expires_on - current_date end as days_left from change_register where classification in ('temporary','emergency') and status = 'started_up' order by expires_on nulls last

sections.title: Open changes
sections.sql: select code, site, title, change_type as type, classification as class, risk_level as risk, status, owner, target_date, open_actions from change_register where status not in ('closed','rejected','cancelled') order by code

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select code, change, site, phase, kind, description, owner, due, attention from action_queue where done_on is null order by due
